column1: # Secrets manifest (PUBLIC: names, paths, owners and modes only; never values). Tab-separated, one row per SSM parameter.
# Read by scripts/fetch-secrets.sh. Adding a service: add the parameter in terraform/edge/ssm.tf, add a row here,
# apply, then run scripts/set-secret.sh. scripts/test-fetch-secrets.sh checks that this file and ssm.tf agree.
# parameter : name under /home-lab/ (secrets are SecureString; config/* are String owned by Terraform)
# target    : file under the secrets dir (default /apps/secrets); no leading slash, no ..
# owner     : numeric uid:gid of the file; mode: octal, e.g. 0400
# required  : yes   = fail closed if the parameter is missing or still holds the UNSET- placeholder
#             no    = omit the file while the placeholder is in place
#             empty = write an EMPTY file while the placeholder is in place (e.g. Tailscale after the node has joined)
# format    : raw = file holds the value exactly; env:NAME = a line NAME=value appended to the target
#             (several rows may share one env: target, which must agree on owner and mode)
authentik/secret-key
authentik/postgres-password
authentik/bootstrap-password
traefik/breakglass-htpasswd
tailscale/auth-key
homepage/authentik-token
config/domain
config/route53-zone-id
config/ra-trust-anchor-arn
config/ra-acme-profile-arn
config/ra-acme-role-arn
